seo.title: Free Online Skin Analysis: What a 60-Second Face Scan Can Help You Understand | MyMirror
seo.description: See how a free MyMirror face scan helps you understand visible acne, oiliness, marks, texture and skin signals in about 60 seconds—without treating the result as a diagnosis.
seo.h1: Free online skin analysis, without the beauty score.

primary.label: Start your free skin analysis now
primary.microcopy: Scan your face to understand visible acne, oiliness, marks, texture, and skin signals in about 60 seconds.

sections.heading: Free online skin analysis, without the beauty score.
sections.markdown: MyMirror helps readers understand visible acne, oiliness, marks, texture and skin signals in about 60 seconds. The scan is a starting point, not a diagnosis.

sections.heading: What an online skin analysis is for
sections.markdown: The page explains that a face scan organizes visible patterns by region and helps readers choose a routine priority without treating the result as clinical certainty.

sections.heading: When a scan can be useful
sections.markdown: Two India-relevant scenarios show how readers can reduce product guessing and describe visible concerns more clearly.

sections.heading: When to scan—and when not to
sections.markdown: The page states that MyMirror does not diagnose conditions or replace a qualified dermatologist, especially for painful, rapidly changing, bleeding, or persistent concerns.

sections.heading: Your next step
sections.markdown: Start by seeing what is visible today, then choose one sensible next step.
